title: Age-specific prognosis comparisons between intrahepatic and extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma depend on death endpoint definitions and primary sequence eligibility
description: Analysis code and non-identifiable aggregate results for age-specific cholangiocarcinoma prognosis comparisons across death endpoints and registry-recorded primary sequence. Includes 2,000 paired patient-cluster bootstrap samples with fixed ridge regularization, classification crosswalks, directed reclassification sensitivity, all-cause mortality, baseline summaries and supplementary anatomical analyses. No patient records or fitted patient-level model objects are distributed.
